__STUB__
Genki girl sprints ahead of group toward surf, arm pumping overhead, striped swimsuit catching bright noon glare.
Bookish boy perched under yellow parasol adjusting glasses, manga open on knees, sandals neatly paired beside towel.
Swim-club captain with goggles pushed up scans lanes, whistle ready, focused grin beneath sun-bleached hair.
Upperclassman girl sorts snacks from cooler with careful hands, nudging juniors toward the shady spot she claimed first.
Shaved-ice cart girl mid-scoop in blue-striped apron, syrup bottle tilted, cheeks rosy from the busy lunchtime rush.
Lifeguard boy sits tall on wooden chair, whistle at lip, shade of cap framing his relaxed but watchful expression.
Small kid crouches at tide pool, bucket gripped with both hands, nose nearly touching a whorled spiral shell.
Twin siblings in matching green rashguards mid-high-five, sea spray caught mid-air around their laughing mirrored faces.
Energetic class-rep girl rallies beach-volleyball team with double thumbs-up, sun-visor slightly sideways from running over.
Shy junior boy sits on dry sand sketching horizon line in notebook, knees drawn up, water bottle forgotten beside him.
Freestyle-swimmer girl tightens goggles on forehead before sprint start, orange swim-cap bright against a clear morning sky.
Responsible club-captain upperclassman counts heads with clipboard, sunscreen tube poking from tote, warm patient smile.
First-time-beachgoer younger sibling clutches inflatable ring tightly, wide eyes watching waves from the very edge of wet sand.
Yakisoba-stall boy ladles noodles in festival apron, paper fan tucked in waistband, cheerfully calling to passing classmates.
Beach-patrol girl strides shoreline with whistle swinging, ponytail high, confident stride keeping rhythm with rolling surf.
Film-camera enthusiast boy kneeling on towel adjusting focus, viewfinder at eye, capturing friends mid-splash in perfect frame.
Shell-collector girl drops three new finds into mesh bag, eyes already scanning the next stretch of glittering wet sand.
Young homeroom teacher in wide-brim hat and swim cover steps carefully into foam, surprised laugh as cold water hits ankles.
Ukulele-strummer girl cross-legged near shoreline at dusk, fingers picking cheerful chords, flip-flops kicked off nearby.
Sporty twin brother-and-sister pair pass volleyball between them, matching wristbands flashing as they dive and recover.
Coconut-vendor boy hoists tray high above head weaving through beach towels, practiced balance keeping drinks perfectly steady.
Crab-spotter boy points excitedly into rock crevice, shorts soaked to knee, bucket dangling forgotten from one triumphant hand.
Swim-team girl with board tucks surfboard under arm and trots toward break, bright wax comb looped at wrist.
Quiet reserved senior boy sits back on towel gazing at distant horizon, half-eaten popsicle melting slow in summer heat.
